limitations: Contracted native gate PASS after a post-hoc one-sided no-repeated-loss criterion correction. Original symmetric Hb-mass diagnostic remains FAIL and non-gating. Small positive gain remains unexplained; no conservation claim. See checks.json for gains and executed repeat/restore statuses.
A 30% acute Hb-species mass reduction plus empirical cardiovascular resistance-baseline change, not haemorrhage, isolated Hb manipulation, or instant clinical anaemia.
No repeated multiplicative loss is visible and sampled action flags are clear. The failed symmetric mass-constancy assertion must not be described as proof of action reapplication.
Arterial content and delivery are direct native derived outputs; checking their algebra is implementation consistency, not independent physiological validation.
Global haemoglobin blood concentration differs from aortic Hb-species concentrations; SaO2 is aortic while pulse oximetry is right arm.
CO is last completed cardiac-cycle output; aortic content and saturation are instantaneous. The model multiplies these mixed-time-semantics quantities, not cycle-matched assays.
Pulse collection serialization omits pending AcuteAnemia at this commit; the individual action serialization was preserved from the native log.
Actual timestamps have floating-point accumulation. Every selected row is original; 60s sample is before action and first post-action native row is 60.02s (not selected in 1s playback).
Fictional standard adult, same pinned build/platform; no clinical or learner validation, treatments, or causal attribution of compensation to one mechanism.
